voice.summary: Sounds like a good analyst explaining a chart: plain, patient and focused on understanding. It values clarity over decoration and says what each visual helps people see.
dos: Name the insight each chart supports
Use plain verbs like share, show and understand
donts: Do not use data science jargon

taglines: Insights that are easy to share
boilerplate: Designy helps teams turn raw data into clear, compelling visuals, making insights easier to share, understand and act on, supported by plain documentation.

microcopy.success: Visual created. Share it with your team.
microcopy.error: We couldn't build that chart. Check your data.
microcopy.empty: No data yet. Upload a file to start.

logo.note: A bar chart motif says data visuals in the simplest way.
